expected_findings.description: acquire() does not catch filelock.Timeout, allowing the implementation-internal exception to leak to callers instead of raising a domain exception like ProjectLock does.
Unchecked _git call in the detached-HEAD guard can silently pass on unexpected git failure; should use _git_ok instead to ensure proper error handling.
Redundant mkdir inside acquire() since __init__ already creates .imp/ unconditionally.
Git subprocess calls lack timeout= parameter; a hung process would block indefinitely (pre-existing pattern, not a blocker for this task).
Test only confirms re-acquire in same process; a cross-process contention test would close the gap before later tasks rely on the lock for correctness.
